title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Welcome, Birthday, Review and Referral Bonuses
content:
**1. Availability.** Marlowe Rewards bonus points are available on their posting date. They are never pending.

**2. Welcome bonus.** The welcome bonus of 500 points posts once in a customer's lifetime, on the first enrolment.

**3. Former birthday posting clause.** The clause "the birthday bonus of the birthday points of the tier held on the posting date posts on the first day of the birth month recorded in the customer's date of birth; a tier whose value is 0 receives no birthday entry" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Birthday tenure.** A birthday bonus posts only if the membership was enrolled at least 30 calendar days before the bonus posting date. Tenure days are counted as calendar days between the enrolment date and the posting date, and exactly the minimum qualifies. The enrolment date is read from the membership record.

**5. Product reviews.** A product review earns 50 points when two things hold: the review is published, and the reviewed product is on a dispatched order of the member. At most 4 review bonuses post in a calendar month. Reviews beyond that limit earn nothing and are not carried into the next month.

**6. Referrals.** A referral earns the referral bonus of the tier held on the posting date. The bonus posts 30 calendar days after the referred friend's first order is dispatched, provided two things hold for that order: its merchandise after discounts was at least 75.00 USD, and it has not been fully refunded. At most 10 referral bonuses post in a calendar year.

**7. Membership status.** Birthday, review, referral and goodwill bonuses post only while the membership is in status active. The welcome bonus posts with the enrolment itself.

**8. Former reference clause.** The clause "each bonus type posts at most once per bonus reference for a customer" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

## Clause 4 on hypothetical dates

| Enrolment date | Bonus posting date | Calendar days between | Clause 4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 May 2025 | 1 June 2025 | 30 | Met, because exactly the minimum qualifies |
| 3 May 2025 | 1 June 2025 | 29 | Not met |

## Clauses 5 to 7 in practice (hypothetical members)

| Situation | Effect |
|---|---|
| Fifth published verified review in the same calendar month | Earns nothing, and is not carried into the next month |
| Review of a product that is on no dispatched order of the member | Earns nothing |
| Friend's first order had 75.00 USD of merchandise after discounts and was partly refunded | Can earn the referral bonus |
| Friend's first order was fully refunded | No referral bonus |
| Eleventh qualifying referral in a calendar year | No referral bonus |
| Membership suspended when a review is published | No review bonus |

superseded_clauses: The birthday bonus of the `birthday_bonus_points` of the tier held on the posting date posts on day `birthday_bonus_posting_day` of the birth month recorded in the customer's date of birth; a tier whose value is 0 receives no birthday row.
Each bonus type posts at most once per bonus reference for a customer.
